newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK CIVIL AVIATION STAFF ANNOUNCES WALKOUTS.
newsitem.headline: GREEK CIVIL AVIATION STAFF ANNOUNCES WALKOUTS.

text.p: Greek civil aviation employees announced three four-hour walkouts next week to press pay and organisational demands, their union said in a statement.

The Confederation of Civil Aviation Unions (OSYPA) said it would stage the work stoppages at 0900 GMT next Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, threatening with flight disruptions during the week before Greek Orthodox Easter.
OSYPA wants Greece's civil aviation authority to have more independence from the government and demands that the government honours pledges for more bonus and overtime pay.

"There is great concern in our sector over the continuing uncertainty over the future of the civil aviation authority and the inexplicable failure to pay employees money owed to them," OSYPA said in a statement.
